title: Caveman: A Claude Code skill that forces your AI to talk like a literal caveman

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Why use many token when few token do trick? Caveman is a clawed code skill that forces your AI to talk like a literal caveman. No pleasantries, no filler paragraphs, no hedging, just barebones primitive sentences with 100% of the technical accuracy intact. Cuts output tokens by up to 75%. It even autoreverts to normal English for critical security warnings before doing something destructive.
